# ghost/game-2048

2048 (Privacy Friendly, F-Droid): start a new game, swipe left/right/up/down (single or a sequence), restart and read the 4x4 grid, points and record. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/game-2048
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/game-2048 new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/game-2048 swipe --device <serial> --param direction=<direction>
ghost skill run ghost/game-2048 play_moves --device <serial> --param directions=<directions>
ghost skill run ghost/game-2048 restart --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/game-2048 get_board --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a new 2048 game
- `swipe`: Swipe left in 2048
- `play_moves`: Play 2048: swipe left, up, left, down, left, up
- `restart`: Restart the 2048 game
- `get_board`: What does my 2048 board look like?
